menu.title: Chicken Makhni Karahi
menu.desc: Fresh tender chicken simmered in a traditional clay handi with ripe Sindh tomatoes, freshly pounded ginger juliennes, green chilies, and authentic Desi Makhan.

menu.title: Mutton Shinwari Karahi
menu.desc: Pure Peshawari Shinwari style fresh young mutton cooked in its own natural fat, coarse sea salt, black pepper, and whole tomatoes. No onions.

menu.title: Special Chicken Dum Biryani
menu.desc: Long-grain aged Basmati rice layered with succulent marinated chicken, saffron milk, caramelized brown onions, golden potato, and aromatic kewra.

menu.title: Reshmi Chicken Malai Boti
menu.desc: Boneless chicken cubes steeped in velvety cream, strained yogurt, cardamom, white pepper, and roasted coriander, char-grilled over fragrant coals.

menu.title: Peshawari Beef Chapli Kabab
menu.desc: Traditional flat minced beef patties kneaded with crushed anardana, coriander seeds, fresh mint, scrambled egg, and tomato slice, shallow fried in bone marrow ghee.

menu.title: Sesame Roghni Naan
menu.desc: Pillowy tandoor-baked leavened flatbread brushed with golden desi butter and sprinkled with toasted white sesame seeds.

menu.title: Kulhad Makhni Sweet Lassi
menu.desc: Authentic chilled Punjabi lassi served in an earthen clay kulhad, crowned with a thick dollop of fresh milk malai, pistachio slivers, and saffron syrup.

menu.title: Shahi Gulab Jamun
menu.desc: Warm melt-in-mouth milk solid dumplings fried in pure desi ghee, soaked in rose cardamom sugar syrup, and dusted with silver leaf.
